subject: Private deployment — implementation runway & ops ownership
raw_messages:
From: Samantha Liu <samantha.liu@nimblehealth.com>
To: irene_choi@redwood.ai
Cc: t.price@nimblehealth.com, security@nimblehealth.com
Date: Thu, 18 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Private deploy next steps — network handoff

Hi Irene,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We want to proceed with a private deployment in our us-west-2 VPC and will need the on-prem package for our staging lab. Before we lock dates with infra, the network/security team asked for:

- A minimal list of required VPC peering routes and ports (eg. egress to redwood-managed control plane, health/metrics endpoints).
- Guidance on private endpoints vs NAT egress (we prefer private endpoints where possible).
- Any appliance requirements for the on-prem package (OS, NICs, firewall rules).

I've attached a quick inventory of our staging VPC. Can your team review and give a recommended connectivity checklist so we can sync with our ops calendar?

Appreciate it —
Samantha Liu
Director, Platform Engineering
Nimble Health
[Attachment: nimble_network_inventory.csv (CSV, 28KB)]

-----
From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Liu <samantha.liu@nimblehealth.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 18 Mar 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Private deploy next steps — network handoff

Thanks Samantha — this is perfect. I copied Ben (Implementation PM) and Marissa (Network lead) so we can give a clear connectivity checklist and propose a short onboarding cadence. Quick note up-front: we generally recommend private endpoints for control-plane telemetry and a small number of NAT egress rules for model downloads (for air-gapped variants we can provide an offline bundle).

Proposed immediate next steps:
1) Marissa to review inventory and produce a 1-page connectivity checklist (VPC peering routes, subnets, SG rules).
2) Ben to draft a 4-week implementation runway with milestone owners and a mutually agreed maintenance window.
3) Security questionnaire items (SOC/SIEM endpoints) — we will provide the list and key artifacts by next Tuesday.

Can you confirm target start week (options: Apr 5 or Apr 12)? Once confirmed we'll share a MAP and a short kick-off agenda.

Thanks,
Irene Choi
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference

-----
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: irene_choi@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Cc: Samantha Liu <samantha.liu@nimblehealth.com>, t.price@nimblehealth.com
Date: Fri, 19 Mar 2027 09:48:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Private deploy next steps — network handoff

I've reviewed the inventory (thanks Samantha). Initial findings and clarifying questions below:

Quick summary:
- VPC looks fine for peering; we recommend a dedicated peering connection from the staging VPC to the Redwood Private transit VPC.
- Control plane: allow outbound HTTPS to control.redwood.ai (443) + a signed cert pin on our side.
- Private endpoints: we can provision an interface endpoint for metrics ingestion and model telemetry.
- On-prem appliance: we recommend CentOS 8+ or Ubuntu 20.04+, 2 x 10Gb NICs, 64GB RAM, NVMe preferred for KV cache (details in attachment).

Open questions:
- Do you need the appliance in an isolated VLAN in your data center?
- Will egress to model storage be over S3-compatible endpoints inside your VPC or via a controlled NAT?

I've attached a short ops checklist and an appliance spec. Ben — can you pick owners and draft the milestones (kickoff, network validation, on-prem install, connectivity acceptance, cutover)?

Attachments: redwood_private_onprem_guide.pdf (PDF, 160KB)

-Marissa
Network Implementation Lead | Redwood Inference

-----
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, irene_choi@redwood.ai
Cc: Samantha Liu <samantha.liu@nimblehealth.com>, grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 20 Mar 2027 14:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Private deploy next steps — network handoff

Thanks Marissa — draft MAP below (attached as MUTUAL_ACTION_PLAN_Nimble-Redwood.xlsx). I'll translate these into calendar invites once we pick the start week.

High-level 4-week runway (owner in parentheses):
Wk0 (prep) — Kickoff + account access + inventory confirm (Irene)
Wk1 — Network validation & peering setup (Marissa)
Wk2 — On-prem appliance install in staging, local firewall rules (Nimble ops)
Wk3 — Connectivity acceptance testing, perf smoke tests, rollback plan (Grace)
Wk4 — Production cutover planning / final signoffs (Irene + Nimble)

Deliverables: connectivity checklist, appliance spec, signed acceptance test CSV, cutover runbook.

I will also add a short maintenance window template for the cutover (we typically recommend a 90-minute window with a 30-minute rollback).

Attachments: MUTUAL_ACTION_PLAN_Nimble-Redwood.xlsx (Excel, 42KB)

-Ben Carter
Implementation Program Manager | Redwood Inference

From: Samantha Liu <samantha.liu@nimblehealth.com>
To: irene_choi@redwood.ai
Cc: t.price@nimblehealth.com, ben_carter@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 23 Mar 2027 16:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Private deploy next steps — network handoff

Thanks everyone — Apr 12 works better for our infra team (gives us time to schedule change windows).

A couple clarifications before kickoff:
- We'll put the appliance in an isolated VLAN in staging; ops confirmed NVMe availability.
- Model artifacts will be pulled from an internal S3 bucket in our VPC — we'll add a VPC endpoint and restrict access to the appliance role.
- Security asked if Redwood can provide a short checklist for SIEM/forwarding (we prefer to ingest to our Splunk endpoint).

If you can share the MAP and the SIEM checklist by EOD Friday (Mar 26), we'll lock Apr 12 kickoff.

Looking forward —
Samantha
Director, Platform Engineering | Nimble Health
